reviews.title: Has some improvements needed
reviews.text:
I am a person who has 3 dogs and 7 cats. I am also a disabled person and money is not easy to come by. I do like this game because it is helping other dogs and the shelters housing them.

However the game itself is tedious and a bit boring. Board game layout, roll the die and move around the board. Each tile has something to collect (albeit most are +6 “kibbles”) to help you progress and send treats to the sponsor dog.

There are mini games but I have recently found that I rarely land on the games tiles. When I do, it will be a mini game that I will have already maxed out. This makes it much harder to obtain a shield to make sure you do not lose the sponsor dog.

I did the update but the event available is for players with unlimited deliveries which is paywall number one. I get that in order to supply shelters with the items is expensive and that offering a subscription service allows for more funding but it seems that it could have been done (like many other apps) where you get basic rewards as a free player and premium rewards for people subscribed. This way no one is left out.

I have also noticed that the most recent update has seen a decline in the amount of kibble you can gain from petting the virtual pup. Prior to the update, you were able to pet the pup 5 times between each roll. This meant 15 kibbles per roll. reviews.title: It is doing a good deed but
reviews.text: Everyday, I visit my dogs and when I tried feeding them the app is always glitching, can't even open like seriously. I only wanted to give my dogs some treats but there is something wrong with the app. I thought you should know about it. And also, I hope I can have a video of my own dog, eve just a short one only. So I will be happy to see them.

reviews.title: Glitches continuously
reviews.text:
When I can play the game it’s cute and I enjoy it. In half hour of playing though if glitched and locked my phone up 5 times. I have to close the app down over and over once my phone manages to unfreeze. 

Fix the glitch and I’d happily play it and sit through the ads if it works.

reviews.title: The games a good idea
reviews.text: The games a good idea but the adds in it are horrendous, you can’t close them off , they appear every 10 seconds, I’m beginning to loose patience with the game just because of the adds
